• Equal Breathing: helps you to relax, focus, and be present.
• Box Breathing: also known as four-square breathing, is a simple and highly effective technique for stress relief.

• Custom Pattern: create unlimited breathing patterns with half a second adjustment.
• Sequences: chain your custom patterns into one longer session. Add any patterns in any order and choose how many cycles to repeat each one — when one finishes, the next starts automatically.

KEY FEATURES:
• Breath Holding Test: Assess and monitor your breath-holding capacity.
• Breathe Reminders: Set notifications to stay on track with your breathing practice.

• Progress Tracking: Visualize your journey with intuitive charts.
• Fully Customizable: Tailor durations, sounds, and voices to suit your preferences.
• Flexible Time Duration: Change time duration based on the number of cycles.

• Dark Mode: Optimize your experience with a sleek, dark-themed interface.
• Unrestricted Access: Enjoy all features with no limitations.

quotes.text:
Hello everyone!

I hope you all are doing well. I have released this breathing exercise app to help shed some stress and anxiety that we all are experiencing during these difficult times.

Breathe has 3 different breathing exercises which are as follows:
- Equal Breathing: helps you to relax, focus, and be present.
- Box Breathing: also known as four-square breathing heighten performance and concentration while also being a powerful stress reliever.
- 4-7-8 Breathing: also called “The Relaxing Breath,” promotes better sleep and eases the body into a state of calmness and relaxation.
The app also offers the breath-holding test which you can use to test your breath-holding capacity and track it in the app daily.

Features:
- All the exercises are free without any ads :)
- Set notifications to get breathe reminders.
- Guided breathing with the relaxing nature sound.
- Track your progress with intuitive charts.
- Connect the Health App to track your mindful minutes. (iOS only)
- Customizable time duration.

Please feel free to offer your suggestions for more exercise or anything that I can improve in the app. I would love to hear your feedback.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.havabee.breathe
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/breathe-relax-focus/id1506712199
